newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss KOF sees no economic worsening, barometer up.
newsitem.headline: Swiss KOF sees no economic worsening, barometer up.

text.p: Switzerland's Centre for Research of Economic Activity (KOF) said the KOF/ETH barometer had again risen in September and the Swiss economy should not worsen any further for the remainder of this year.

KOF, part of the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich (ETH), also said in a statement that capacity utilisation in Swiss industry had declined slightly in the third quarter to just below 83 percent.
KOF/ETH's economic barometer, a measure of leading indicators, had risen by 0.1 percent in September from August for a year-on-year rise of 1.1 percent.
This compares with year-on-year increases of 0.9 percent rise in August and a 0.6 percent rise in July, KOF said.
"Based on the continous rise in the barometer during the first half of 1996 one can assume that the economy will not worsen further in the remaining months of the year," KOF said.

KOF said the movements in the individual indicators in September was similar to last month and the indicator for construction activity had continued to decline, while the indicator for order levels in the machinery industry had risen.
The capacity utilisation figure is based on a regular survey of more than 1,600 companies and KOF said the decline was seen in large companies that were oriented toward the domestic market.
